descriptionHtml:
Xprinter XP-370B Direct Thermal Barcode Label Printer

Accelerate your logistics, retail, and inventory management workflow with the high-performance Xprinter XP-370B Direct Thermal Barcode Label Printer. Available at Turbo Computer, this premium hardware component delivers blistering printing speeds up to 152mm/s to handle demanding labeling tasks effortlessly. It stands as the definitive choice for e-commerce hubs, shipping offices, and supermarkets across Egypt looking for a robust hardware modification to upgrade high-volume barcode generation and shipping label tracking configuration.

The Xprinter XP-370B features an advanced 3-inch printing design that accommodates a wide array of thermal label rolls up to 80mm in width. Engineered for maximum workplace efficiency, it comes integrated with an automatic label peeling mechanism that automatically separates the sticker from its backing paper as it prints. With its superior thermal cooling safety, heavy-duty mechanism lifespan, and easy USB connectivity setup, it offers a reliable and highly productive daily business ecosystem.
